Title: List of questions of the Paris EC 2010 Quizz

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Hello,
Here's my list of questions for the EC 2010's quizz.
Orian has his somewhere (I think).

Since the list of answers is quite long and absolutely unreadable,
send me an e-mail if you want it (plus, it's probably not complete. I
was using the ARDB to check artworks and quotes).
They were not all asked.

A - Generic questions
1/ How many European Championships of VTES have been organized, not
including Paris 2010 ?
2/ Where did the previous ECs happen?
3/ Who are the previous EC winners?

B - Questions about Paris
1/ What was Paris' previous name?
2/ In which century did the city change its name to Paris?
3/ In which century did Paris become France's capital?
4/ When was the Eiffel Tower built?
5/ Which city is twin-city with Paris?
6/ What is the name of the bike rental service in Paris?
7/ In which year was Paris' metro opened?
8/ List all crypt and library cards referring to Paris, a place in
Paris (including titles).

C - Knowing the cards
1/ What is the biggest amount a minion could bleed at, given as many
turns and blood / pool as necessary, using only cards in his deck +
crypt? (two answers give a pretty fair amount, one of them uses a 12-
card crypt, the other doesn't)
2/ What is the biggest handstrike value a strike can have?
3/ How many Obfuscate action modifiers can be played on a single
action (you may decide what the action is) ? If the base action is at
+1 stealth, what is the total stealth bonus ?
4/ Which vampire was in the first Turbo deck?
5/ Adana de Sforza has an Ankara Citadel and plays Burning Wratch
against Lucian, the Perfect. How much blood does Adana burn ?
6/ The opposing vampire plays Blissful Agony superior, and would send
me to fight Lorrie. If I play Staredown at superior, can I play
Psyche! ? If I play Staredown at inferior, can I play Psyche! ?
7/ Normal (who has 1 strength) hits a Nephandus with his Weighted
Walking Stick. How many counters are removed from the WWS ?
8/ Mylan is blocked by a vampire. In the combat, Mylan dodges, the
opposing vampire plays Catatonic Fear (sup). Does Mylan burn?

D - Trivia questions
1/ Which vampires from Jyhad and V:tES have been merged into one, due
to a copyright issue of the artwork?
2/ Which set (boosters + starters) had the biggest number of different
cards, including reprints?
3/ Which set introduced the biggest number of different cards?
4/ Which sets had the top 3 biggest number of cards in the boosters?
5/ Which cards have had 3 or more artworks?
6/ Which set dropped the "tm" for a "R" after "DECKMASTER", on the
backside of the cards?
7/ Which library cards from Jyhad aren't in V:tES?
7'/ Which library cards are in V:tES but weren't in Jyhad?
8/ Which cards were introduced with the 10th Anniversary packs?
9/ Who are the artists of the different versions of the Anarch
Troublemaker card?
10/ Name people (players, staff, ...) who have been used as artworks
for cards.
11/ Which cards quote Depeche Mode?
12/ Which (physically) is the biggest card?
13/ Which vampire uses "status counters" ?
14/ List all non-Samedi vampires with thanatosis (inferior or
superior).
15/ Which cards were banned, and later un-banned?
16/ How many Creeds is there? How many virtues is there?
17/ For each discipline, give the name of one of the smallest vampires
to have that discipline at superior.

E - Other
1/ As you might know, Pulp Fiction's poster was edited in France, and
they removed the shocking items from the picture. No, not the gun. The
cigarette. Help us find the crypt cards with cigarette ( / cigar /
anything that the crypt card is smoking) on the artwork [it was added
that the thing the vampire / imbued was smoking had to be visible on
the artwork.]
2/ Which imbueds don't have a nickname (using double quotes in their
name), or don't have a nickname ending with a number?
3/ Is there more men or women amongst the Imbueds? Or is it a tie?
4/ Which crypt card have more than one artworks ? (for this question,
base and advanced vampire are distinct -- Karsh and Karsh adv aren't
considered the same vampire)
5/ Which card in Heirs to the Blood has kept the artwork it had in
Sabbat?
6/ Who is the model used for Camille Devereux's artwork?

No offense, but aren't some of these questions really kind of silly?

On Dec 13, 8:57 am, floppyzedolfin <floppyzedol...@gmail.com> wrote:
> C - Knowing the cards
> 1/ What is the biggest amount a minion could bleed at, given as many
> turns and blood / pool as necessary, using only cards in his deck +
> crypt? (two answers give a pretty fair amount, one of them uses a 12-
> card crypt, the other doesn't)

(For crypts greater than 12): Infinite (or near infinite, depending on
the number of Group 3/4 of 4/5 Caitiff that have been printed). Al-
Muntaquim the Avenger + as many Caitiff as you can possibly lay your
hands on (or have ever been printed).

> 2/ What is the biggest handstrike value a strike can have?

Probably something to do with: Trap + a ridiculous number of Fires in
the Blood + up to 2 cards (for cost reduction or range setting).

Cailean: Trap + Clan Impersonation Ankara Citadel + Shilmulo Tarot +
all other cards are Fire in the Blood

You could also do Merged Menele + Helena, substituting Infernal
Familiar + Fear of the Void Below instead of CI + Ankara.

Besides the Trap + CI + Ankara + Shimulo, the remaining cards (446)
are Fire in the Blood. By passing around the Shilmulo Tarot, you can
have all players' libraries on the Tarot. The initial 7 card hands are
harder to retrieve, but you can claim 2 more cards from each player by
reducing hand sizes with Jan Pieterzoon and Angra Mainyu, while
passing around control of Pochtli. So assume that 5 cards from 4
players are unretrievable, resulting in 426 Fires in the Blood that
will be played.

With Cailean, you play Trap and Fire in the Blood, and then every 4
rounds you play another Fire in the Blood to reset the Trap. You set
range to long every round until the very last

With 426 Fires in the Blood, that should last around 1704 combat
rounds, meaning that the first Fire in the Blood now gives you +3407
hand damage. The second gives you +3399, third is +3391, and the last
one is +7. Add it all up and you should have around +727,182 hand
strength. You can get an additional +1 if you're beating up poor
Basil.

> 3/ How many Obfuscate action modifiers can be played on a single
> action (you may decide what the action is) ? If the base action is at
> +1 stealth, what is the total stealth bonus ?

A ridiculous amount due to Mask of a Thousand Faces.

You have 1 Shilmulo Tarot and 449 Mask of a Thousand Faces. This time
you have to play Group 6. Using the Jan + Angra + Pochtli trick (you
can borrow Pocthli thanks to Josette), you can get access all but
about 5 cards from each other player, so 429 Masks.

You now influence out 430 Hordes (isn't it great that they're
unique?), and go ahead and play 429 Mask of a Thousand Faces.

> 4/ Which vampire was in the first Turbo deck?

That's subjective. Depends on how you define a Turbo deck and what is
considered first. Arika + Soul Gem was around long before The Baron.
But there were certainly Soul Gem decks back in the Jyhad days, though
whether or not they're sufficiently "turbo" (increasing your capacity
was harder back then) is a matter of opinion.

Lucita, in the turbo Lucita deck.

> 5/ Adana de Sforza has an Ankara Citadel and plays Burning Wratch
> against Lucian, the Perfect. How much blood does Adana burn ?

1. Adana and Lucian's specials are applied first, negating each other,
then Adana burns half the blood to pay the card, rounded down.

> 6/ The opposing vampire plays Blissful Agony superior, and would send
> me to fight Lorrie. If I play Staredown at superior, can I play

> Psyche! ? No. There's another combat queued.

> If I play Staredown at inferior, can I play Psyche! ?

Yes, the dodge protects from any negative effects, including starting
a new combat with Lorrie. A new combat may then be started with
Psyche!

> 7/ Normal (who has 1 strength) hits a Nephandus with his Weighted
> Walking Stick. How many counters are removed from the WWS ?

1 because the damage was reduced, not prevented.

> 8/ Mylan is blocked by a vampire. In the combat, Mylan dodges, the
> opposing vampire plays Catatonic Fear (sup). Does Mylan burn?

No, dodge protects from any negative effects from the opposing strike.

Ye I missed the same clan part here, although it seems obvious that the
highest bleed amount attainable without eating Caitiff is to be attained by

Since Camarilla Vitae Slave exists, it's probably best to use Nahir, get
Vitae Slaves until some ideal capacity, then Clan Impersonate to Ishtarri
and start getting Despirals.
If I'm not mistaken this would lead to the following equation (x is amount
of Vitae Slaves)

Bleed Amount = 2 + (10+x)(89-x)
The 2 is from Nahir's +1 bleed.

This function can be written as B(x) = x^2+79x+892 and maximizes for x=39,5.
Obviously we can't put half cards in our library, so we have to use either
39 Vitae Slaves or 40 and unsurprisingly both these give the same amount of
total bleed.

So basically:

Nahir recruits 40 Camarilla Vitae Slaves, making his capacity 50.
Nahir then Clan Impersonates to Ishtarri.
Nahir gets 49 Despirals, filling them all up over the course of a LOT of
turns.

Total bleed: 2452.

Floppy said he had around 2500, but I can't for the life of me think up a
way to get more bleed.

Using Lucian (11-cap)
Discard a card (Despiral)
Lucian Clan Imps to Lasombra. (89 cards left in the deck)
Lucian's capacity is increased by x (CVS, discipline skill-cards, ...)
Lucian burns Clan Imp.
Undele returns Clan Imp, Despiral to the hand (discard 2 Despiral)
Lucian plays Clan Imp to Ishtarri.
Play 89-x Despirals
Lucian performs the Despiral action x+11 for each of the 89-x
Despirals.

Total capacity: 11+x.
Total bleed: 1 + 3 (Lucian) + (11+x)*(89-x) = -x^2 + 79 x + O(1)
Maximum at x=39
Value: 1 + 3 + 50 * 50 = 2504.

There might be more, but this is my max so far.
